baseline_note: adult resting reference; hr_delta = HR - 75 (same as the training data)
selection: NEWS2-normal every second (SpO2 >= 96 and 51 <= HR <= 90); mean HR closest to 75
citation: Pimentel, M. A. F., et al. (2016). Toward a robust estimation of respiratory rate from pulse oximeters. IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering, 64(8), 1914-1923. doi:10.1109/TBME.2016.2613124
note: Real ICU vitals replayed in the demo (not recorded from the participant). Built by ml/make_replay.py.
